risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful quantified information on asset sales, cash, debt repayment, deferred occupancy costs, and segment losses, but also relies on broad qualitative descriptions and optimistic recovery language. Material risks remain, including below-pre-pandemic attendance, deferred liabilities, closed or impaired properties, inflationary costs, and continued cinema-sector pandemic effects.
